issues.on_page: Other: General 32,587, Street 6,023, Public Trust 4,800, Housing 17,196, Other Governmental 1,500
issues.issue: The split of the 'Other' line was rebuilt by matching fund-statement lines (p10, p13, p18-p20) to each column. Street, Public Trust, Housing and Other Governmental match printed totals exactly. General's 32,587 has no printed subtotal; it is what is left (Other rent 24,870 + Library reimbursements 2,278 + Other 5,439) after the lines p4 shows separately. The arithmetic is right, but it is a split by matching rather than a printed breakdown.

Could be homestead/tax credits. The same applies to detail[41] (Street Property tax credit 49, printed under Intergovernmental on p13). Kept as property tax so it agrees with p2/p9 property taxes 56,542, which is defensible.
The same label in the General Fund (detail[23], p11) is supplies and materials. The two lines are categorized differently.
License fees paid could also be professional/contract services or miscellaneous; judgment call.
Street Fund Capital outlay (detail[56]) is construction/infrastructure; the two capital outlay lines are categorized differently.
